Masters

MSDS-534: Statistical Learning for Data Science





Fall 2025,   Fall 2024,   Fall 2023
This class covers the basics of deep learning from a statistical perspective, including feedforward neural networks, convolutional neural networks, recurrent neural networks, transformers, VAEs and diffusion models. Then, we study uncertainty quantification using conformal inference. Finally, we cover hypothesis testing with deep learning.




MSDS-597: Data Wrangling with Python





Spring 2025
This course provides an introduction to the principles and tools to retrieve, “tidy,” clean, and visualize data in preparation for statistical analysis. Principles of reproducibility and reusability are emphasized. It teaches techniques to wrangle and explore data.

About
I am a tenure-track Assistant Professor in the Rutgers Statistics Department. I am also a visiting researcher at the Flatiron Institute.
Previously, I was a postdoc at the Columbia Data Science Institute, working with David Blei. I received my PhD in Statistics from the University of Pennsylvania, advised by Edward George and Veronika Rockova.
My recent research interests include:

developing identifiable and interpretable deep generative models;
improved tools for calibrated model criticism.






Working with me

Rutgers PhD students
Send me an email if you’d like to chat about research!


Prospective PhD students
Please apply to the Rutgers Statistics PhD program and mention my name. Unfortunately I don’t have the bandwidth to reply to every email.


Masters of Data Science students

Capstone Projects
Rutgers MSDS students can use a final project from one of my MSDS classes as their capstone.
For capstones based on group projects, students will have to complete a revision independently using a different statistical method, different dataset, or a different simulation design, and submit both the initial group and final individual report.
Please take my MSDS-534 (Statistical Learning for Data Science) course if you are interested in doing an independent research project with me.
